description: Source code for MemtrackProxy class implementing memory tracking interface via HIDL and AIDL in Android.

classes.name: MemtrackProxy
classes.description: Proxy class for accessing memory tracking services via HIDL and AIDL.

methods.name: MemtrackHidlInstance
methods.description: Returns HIDL instance of IMemtrack service.

methods.name: MemtrackAidlInstance
methods.description: Returns AIDL instance of IMemtrack service.

methods.name: CheckUid
methods.description: Checks if calling UID is authorized (AID_SYSTEM, AID_ROOT, AID_SHELL).

methods.name: CheckPid
methods.description: Checks if calling PID matches requested PID.

methods.name: getMemory
methods.description: Retrieves memory records for a given process ID and type.
